notes.title: Cyberpunk 3776 Steamkeys are now available at Desura
notes.content:
REDEEM KEY AT DESURA: 

The Steam-keys are now avaible on Desura: 

1. After your Login into Desura, go to your collection[www.desura.com] 
2. Search for Cyberpunk and click Keys
3. Copy the provided key and add the game via Steam-client itself (at the lower left corner).
